title: It’s ok
text: It’s ok. This is ok. A bit time consuming to put together. Drawer is pretty janky. I couldn’t attach the top cushion with screws because there are no holes to put the screws into so it kind of just sits on top of the drawer. It looks decent and just like the picture. Holds shoes neatly and socks in the drawer.

product_metadata.title: TLWEINUO Shoe Rack Bench with Leather Cushion Seat and Drawer, 2 Tier Shoe Storage Bench Supports up to 400 Pounds, Wooden Shoe Bench Entryway with Storage for Entryway, Living Room, Bedroom, White
features: HIGH QUALITY: The shoe rack bench seated a soft comfortable leather cushion. Instead of hopping on one leg when putting on shoes, why not take a seat on the cushioned bench comfortably? This storage bench is made from warp-resistant particleboard for long-lasting construction, with no wiggle. And durable material allows this bench to hold up to 400 lbs

DESIGN: This 2-Tier Shoe Storage Bench is designed with simple lines, wooden shelves, and leather cushions. The combination of materials and colors makes this wooden shoe cabinet add a simple and modern feel to your home. And the color matches well almost any furniture style

WIDE APPLICATIONS: Our entryway shoe bench can hold up to 6-8 pairs of shoes, taking up little space while keeping your shoes organized while preventing them from scuffing or getting dirty. The top drawer provides storage space for newspapers, shoe cleaner kits, socks, keys, or other sundries. It is sized to fit well in narrow hallways, foyers, entryways, bedrooms, or living rooms. At the same time, it is also a nice decoration

ESAY TO ASSEMBLE: This shoe bench is easy to assemble, all parts and instructions are included in the package, and we have taken a detailed installation video, you only need to follow the steps that will complete the installation smoothly. It doesn't take too much time to assemble, it takes about 40 minutes for two people to use the power drill, of course, the time required by different people will be different

AFTER-SALES SERVICE & ATTENTIONS: If you have any quality problems or installation problems after receiving the product, please feel free to contact us through Amazon, we will definitely provide you with the best service and provide you with the most suitable solution. Tip: For higher efficiency, we recommend using a POWER DRILL and setting it at LOW speed to avoid screw stripping.
